library.title: Library
library.empty: The library is empty. Add frames with the Import frames and Folder buttons in the top bar, or from the File menu.
library.description: Click a frame to open it in the viewer. The eye button excludes it from processing without removing it from the library.

data.title: Capture data
data.pixelsOnlyWithObject: {format} files contain only pixels: no exposure, date, filter or sky position. The image is treated as already stacked. The object is taken from the file name; to mark objects on the image, use Plate solve in the Objects step.
data.pixelsOnlyWithoutObject: {format} files contain only pixels: no exposure, date, filter or sky position. The image is treated as already stacked. To recognize objects, their name must be in the file name (for example “M_27.tif”), or use a FITS or XISF file with a header.

focuser.name: Focuser
focuser.hint: Focuser position recorded by the instrument, useful for finding focus again

location.name: Observing site
location.hint: Latitude and longitude declared in the file header

bayer.name: Bayer matrix
bayer.hint: Pattern of color filters on the sensor, used to reconstruct color

pixelScale.name: Pixel scale
pixelScale.hint: Portion of sky covered by a single pixel, in arcseconds

stats.title: Signal statistics
stats.description: Values normalized between 0 and 1. The median, the middle value of all pixels, indicates the sky background level.

noise.name: Estimated noise
noise.hint: Noise estimate that is barely affected by stars. The lower the value, the cleaner the image

saturated.name: Saturated pixels
saturated.hint: Percentage of pixels at the top of the scale, usually the cores of the brightest stars
